dpe skrun gsal bshad/de'ang tang dang rgyal khab kyi yang dag pa'i mi rigs srid jus kyi dgongs 'dun las lo bcu'i zang zing khrod rgyal yongs spyi mtshungs bzhin rang re bod gangs can gyi rig gnas che phra mtha' yas par yang god chags ci che byung ba rnams nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel byung dang 'byung bzhin pa ni mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dbus ljongs gcig dang zhing chen bzhi'i dpe skrun khang so so nas bod dpe ji snyed cig deng gi lugs gsar dpe deb tu dpar bskrun byung ba der bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'di bzhin rgyun 'dzin dang / shes rtogs/ nyams zhib bcas byed par med du mi rung ba zhig tu 'gyur bzhin yod mur/ rang re'i bod 'di ni sngar nas da bar chos la dad cing phyag 'tshal skor sbyong dang gnas skor lta skor sogs la 'gro srol yod pa la/ lhag par du deng dus rgyal khab phyi nang gi yul skor spro 'cham grangs kyis mi lang ba rang ljongs kyi gnas gzigs su yong bar dmigs te sngonabyon skyes chen du mas gnas yig mang po bris gnang mdzad kyang par du 'khod pa nyung la 〈dbus gtsang gnas yig 〉 tsam las yongs khyab kyi rang bzhin mi ldan zhing / la la shin tu rgyas la rgyan gyis bcings pas phal mo ches rtogs mi thub pa/ gzhan yang sa ming ngam/ 'gro lam/ srid 'dzin sa khongs bcas par yang 'pho 'gyur chen po byung stabs da lta ngos zin dka' ba bcas la dmigs te da lam kho bos kron chus so so byas nas 'bri 'char yod
pa la/ thog mar gangs can mes po'i 'byung gnas yul yar klungs te lho kha nas 'go 'dzugs rgyu rten 'brel mi log pa'i tshul gyis thog mar 〈lho kha sa khul gyi gnas yig 〉'di nyid bris pa mkhas pa dgyes pa'i skyes su 'os pa zhig min yang sngar dpe dang mi 'dra sa ni/ deng gi bod gsar pa'i rdzong khag so so byas nas bris yod pa dang gcig 'gro skyod ni 'khor lam ded nas bris pa dang /de la'ang snum nag 'khor lam dang / gzhung lam/ 'khor lam spyir btang ba/rkang lam bcas la dbyer te de dag gi bar thag spyi le'ang bkod yod pa dang gnyis/ gnas dang dgon pa so so'i phyag 'debs pa po dang / chos lugs grub mtha'/ rten gsum bcas par 'pho 'gyur byung tshul sogs sku gnyer gyi zhal rgyun/ rgan rabs tsho'i ngag rgyun gtso bor bzhag ste bris pa dang / de dag gi phyi dbyibs sku dpar re'ang bkod yod pa dang gsum/ zhar du 'gro bde 'tshol bde'i ched stabs bde'i sa bkra re'ang bkod yod pa dang bzhi bcas kyis dad ldan gnas skor ba dang / nyams zhib pa/ yul skor spro 'cham pa bcas la dkar chag lam yig gi tshul du 'bul zhu byas pa 'dis gangs can bod kyi rig gnas kyi sdong por slar yang 'dab lo rgyas pa dang /me tog bzhad pa/ 'bras bu 'dogs pa bcas yong ba'i lhag bsam zol med kyi smon pa brgya phrag dang bcas/gnas bshad 'bri ba pos 1999lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes la/

la dmar po'i nor sgrub yod pas de gter nas longs shig ga ces lung bstan byung ba ltar nor gter blangs nas gnas de dag btab ces kyang gsungs srol yod/ dgon de ni bsam gas las khyad du 'phags pa zhig yod pas lnga ldan grwa tshang zhes zhu don ni/ khor sa dang po bsam yas las gzhu 'dom gang gis rgya che bas gcig khor sa bar ma'i steng sangs rgyas stong gi ldebs ris yod pas gnyis/ steng mchog za mchog rgyal po ra hu lar gnyer gtad pas gsum/ bar thog rgyal po shing bya can la gnyer gtad pas bzhi/ 'og thog klu rgyal mal gro gzi can la gnyer gtad pa dang spyi'i bka' srung zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul yin pas lnga bcas kyis lnga ldan grwa tshang zhes pa'i mtshan de ltar byung / dbu rtse ni lugs gsum can bsam yas dang 'dra la/ de 'brel gyi rten sku khyad du 'phags pa bzhugs pa las jun gar dmag dus gsung 'byon pa'i rdo rje 'chang ge sku brnyan 66a tsha 9nyam zhes pa sogs ji snyed yod/ dgon de thog mar rnying dgon yin pa la rgyal mchog lnga pas mtshan don grub rdo rje zhes gsol ba'i dgon de'i mkhan po kun dga' mkhyen brtse phun tshogs kyi dus su sa lugs phyag bzhes gnang /da lta sngon gyi 'du khang nyams gso zhus pa'i nang snga bar phyis gsum gyi rtsa che'i ldebs ris mjal rgyu yod la/ gsar bzhengs ston pa'i sku brnyan dang /grwa pa mngon shes sogs kyi sku brnyan yang mjal rgyu yod/byams pa gling / gra thang dgon nas shar gyi ri khug tu byams pa gling zhol grong brgyud spyi le gnyis tsam 'khor lam ded phyin na dgon der slebs/dgon de ni thog mar thu mi sam bho ṭa nas gdung rabs bcu gnyis pa drung chen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la sras gnyis byung ba'i gcen dge bsnyen lhun grub bkra shis kyis btab/ sras gnyis pa byams gling pa bsod nams rnam
rgyal dang / lo chen bsod nams rgya mtshos mchod rten bzhengs/ bod du chos 'khor mchod rten yod tshad kyi nang nas khyad du 'phags pa yin zhes gsungs/chos 'khor grwa tshang dang / mkhar grwa tshang / chos pa'i grwa tshang / klu sdeng grwa tshang bcas grwa tshang lnga las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi mdzad pa shin tu rgyas te dge 'dun zhal grangs tshig stong la nye ba byung zhes gsungs/ de nas dus rabs bco lnga tsam na rje rin po che'i dngos slob paṇa chen bsod nams rnam rgyal dgon der byon te grwa tshang lnga po gcig tu sgril/ mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang thog so bcu bdun can la nyams gso mdzad/ de rjes skyabs rje 'bul dod rin po ches mchod rten la nyams gso rgya che gnang / kun gling tsha shag sku ngo bstan pa bsod nams zhu ba byams gling bla brang bzung gnang skabs mchod rten la zangs kyi wa mdong btsugs nas char chus mi gnod pa byas/ mchod rten de ni bal yul mchod rten bya ru kha shor la dpe byas pa yin zer/ sngon lo ltar bod zla 1tshes 1nas 7bar byams gling tshong 'dus zhes bal bod 'brug gsum 'dzoms srol yod/ bal po'i tshong pas mchod rten gyi rtse nas ras ka ci slongs kyi red/ ka ci ji tsam ring ba de tsam gyis tshong legs pa'i rtags yin zhes kyang zer/da lta byams khang gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i nang sngon gyi rten tsan dan gyi byams pa khru gang pa can/ gsar bzhengs sman 'dam gyi byams pa thog so gsum ldan/ paṇa chen bsod nams rnam rgyal gyi sku dmar gdung gi lhu tshigs bzhugs pa'i sman 'dam gyi 'dra sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/ sems nyid byams pa zhes sku 'dra rtsa chen zhig sngon dus 'gyur gong bor brlags song ba da lta 'brug yul du yod skad bcas so//ri bo rnam rgyal/ mtshan bsdus par 66 ri rnam dgon 99 zhes zhu/
26 gla nang rdzong khongs/—byams gling zhol nas phu ru spyi le drug tsam 'khor lam ded nas lce'u smad dam jo smad grong brgyud song na shar gyi ri steng nas dgon de mjal/ lce'u smad ces pa ni sngon rdzo bo spun gsum bsam yas su phebs mkhan yin pa la sa der zhag gcig bzhugs/ phyi nyin jo bo gnyis bsam yas su phebs/ gcig gis nga 'dir sdod kyi yin gsungs nas jo smad dang jo stod ces pa'i ming byung ba'i zur las da lta'i na(lce'u smad ji ces pa'i sgra de byung zer/ ri bo rnam rgyal ni rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob paṇa chen dge 'dun rgyal pos phyag btab gnang mdzad/ ri bo rnam rgyal dang / ri bo chos gling / ri bo bde chen bcas bgres gzhon gsum gyis dgon re btab gnang ba zer/ thog ma nas mdo sngags gnyis ka phyag bzhes mdzad pa'i dge ldan pa'i dgon pa yin/ dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu skor yod/ sngon dgon der rten gsum ji snyed yod pa las gtso sku jo bo mi 'gyur rdo rje zhes jun gar bas 'jor zhus rjes rim bzhin gsos pa zhig dang bka' gdams mchod rten mi tshad la zin tsam gsum sogs yod/da lta jo khang nyams gso gnang ba'i nang gsar bzhings jo bo'i thugs kur sngon gyi gzungs rang 'jags phul ba zhig dang / bka' gdams mchod rten gcig gi chos 'khor dang pad ma nyams gso gnang ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/dga' tshal sbyag lce'u smad grong nas phu ru spyi le gsum tsam 'khor lam spyir btang ba ded song na rgyal gling grong du 'byor zhing / grong de'i dbus rgyal gling dgon rnying nyams gso ma byung ba de mjal rgyu yod/ thog mar gnas de gra nang skyes bu bcu gsum gyi ya gyal rgyal ba yar rgyab pa'i pha gzhis yin pas rgyal gling zhes dang / de kha che paṇa chen nam dngos slob mkhan chen
byang chub dpal ba la phul bas kha che paṇa chen gyis gra nang rgyal gling tshogs pa/gra phyi tshong 'dus tshogs pa/ sne gdong rtse tshogs pa/ gtsang gi chos lung tshogs pa bcas tshogs pa sde bzhi btab pa'i ya gyal rgyal gling tshogs pa ni dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i dus 'gor phyag btab gnang mdzad/ sngon nang rten ji snyed cig yod pa las chos dung 'dzam gling sgra dbyangs kyi steng du mun nag nang me 'od ltam mer 'phro ba'i g.yu zhig yod pa de'ang yar rgyab pa'i bla g.yu yin zhes brjod/ gzhan yang rdza mkhan ltag khung nyi shar gyis bzhengs pa'i kha che paṇa chen gyi 'dra sku dang / 'jang rnying ma zhes pa'i zhal thang sogs yod/da lta dgon de nyams gso ma 'grub pas de nas byang shar mtshams su spyi le gcig tsam song na dga' tshal sbug tu 'byor/ dga' tshal sdug ni gnas brtan dpa' bo sku phreng dang po rgyal gling tshogs pa'i gzhung chen bcu gsum bshad khrid gnang yul du phyag btab/ thog mar kha che paṇa chen gyi lugs te 'dul ba'i lugs kho na 'dzin pa la/ rim bzhin chos lugs ris med phyag len mdzad pas ma tshad yi ge 'bri sbyong nas dbu btsugs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun gsan sbyang gnang srol yod par grags/da lta dga' tshal sbug 'du khang gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i nang kha che paṇa chen gyi rdza sku byin can dang / gsar bzhengs mkhan slob chos gsum gyi snang brnyan sogs mjal rgyu yod/ kha che paṇa chen gyi rdza sku ni rdza mkhan ltag khung nyi shar gyis bzhengs pa yin zer/ ltag khung nyi shar zhes pa zhogs par rang khyim nas rtag tu paṇa chen gyi mdun du chos zhu bar 'ong bas ltag khung la nyi ma shar ba dang / dgong dro nyi ma nub rir bzhud pa'i skabs rang khyim du log 'gro skabs ltag khung la nyi ma shar bas ltag khung nyi shar zhes pa de ltar thogs/ rdza mkhan paṇa chen la dad gus che bas paṇa chen gyi 'dra sku bdun bzhengs pa'i grabs byas te bzhugs khri bzos/ 'on kyang sku bzhings mi shes
28 gra nang rdzong khongs/wawa — wa wapas khri re'i steng du 'dam bag rdog re bzhag ste gnyid du yur ba gnyid las sad skabs khri re'i steng du sku byon legs re rang bzhin du phebs zhes zer/rdza sku de rnams las sa steng / sa 'og sa bla gsum la re re dang / tshogs pa sde bzhir sku re yod pa las da lta rgyal gling dga' tshal sbug tu bzhugs pa 'di nyid las mja'/ rgyu med gsungs/stod grong dgon/ rgyal gling tshogs pa nas 'khor lam brgyud mu mthud spyi le drug tsam song na bkra shis gling grong du 'byor zhing de nas grong de'i byang ngos ri 'dabs su song na dgon de yod/ dgon de ni rgyal ba klong chen rab 'byams pa'i 'khrungs yul yin la gdan sa gtso bo'ang yin/ rgyab ri'i ldebs su rgyal ba klong chen pa'i sgrub phug dang / sgrub chu/ dur khrod sogs mjal rgyu yod/ rgyal ba klong chen pa ni slob dpon pad 'byung gi dngos slob rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang gdung gcig pa'i rab las mched pa slob dpon bstan pa srung dang / yum 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi gdung las mched pa 'brom bza' ma bsod nams rgyan gnyis kyi sras su 1308lor sku 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen 'khrungs rjes dmar 'byar dus yum gyis zhing gi mu khar bzhag ste zhing las gnang bzhin pa'i skabs glo bur du char pa chen po rig babs pas ma gza' dam gsum gyis kun mkhyen khyim du gdan drangs/ yum gyis bu len du 'gro skabs bzhugs med pas khyim du phebs pas kun mkhyen khyim du gdan drangs yod pa dang / lha mo er ka dza tis yum la bka' bkyon yang gnang / de nas sku na rim son kun mkhyen du ngos 'dzin zhus/ mdzad 'phrin shin tu rgyas/ mtshan snyan yangs pa'i khyon la khyab/ bod gangs can gyi grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas pa mang pos/ sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pa/ rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa
bcas gsum ni gangs can gyi 66 'jam dbyangs rnam gsum nya yin zhes gsungs/da lta gsar bzhengs 'du khang nang kun mkhyen klong chen pa dang chos sku kun bzang / rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa sogs kyi 'dra sku gsar bzhengs gnang pa mjal rgyu yod/yang dgon de'i rgyab ri'i stod lung gnas nang gi dgon lag kurma bka' brgyud pa'i jo dgon zhig kyang mjal rgyu yod/orgyan gling / mtshan rgyas par 64gra stod yar rje o rgyan gling ji zhes zhu/ stod grong nas lho ngos su spyi le gnyis gsum tsam song na yar rje grong dbus su dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ 66 yar nyagazhes pa ni stod kyi don dang der 'khrungs pa'i rje o rgyan gling pas yar rje zhes pa'i ming de ltar byung / lha sras don grub rgyal po'i skye ba bdun pa yar rje o rgyan gling pa de nyid 1323lor sngags rgyud khyad par can du sku 'khrungs/ sku chung dus nas mthu dang sman rtsis sogs la mkhas par sbyangs/ dgung lo nyer gsum par bsam yas mchod rten dmar po nas gter gyi kha byang bzhes te shel brag gi rgyab phyogs brag pad ma brtsegs pa'i shel phug nas zab gter gyi mdzod bzhes/ de nas khra 'brug khul du bka' 'dus kyi dbang gnang skabs lung bstan gyi tshig zur gyi rkyen pas sne'u gdong byang chub rgyal mtshan dang thugs mi mthun pa'i tshul byas e brgyud dwags por phebs te e 'dabs blo chung bya bar sku gshegs/ sku gdung dwags pos spyan drangs/ phyis sku rabs sde pa las can zhig gis skye bdun myong grol du grags pa shes nas sku sha cung zad zhud cing nyams pas sde pa nyams 'bar te sa las khru gang tsam gyis 'phags nas skyong thub pa sogs kyi snyan grags khyab mthar sku gdung sne gdong ban tshang du bzhugs skor gsham du sne
gdong rdzong khongs ban tshang gi dkar chag tu gzigs/ yongs grags su dgon de o rgyan gling pas phyag btab gnang zhes kyang / la las mnga' sde shes rab bzang pos phyag btab gnang ba yin zhes kyang gsungs/ dgon de'i phyi brtsigs sngon gyi de rang yin pas de'ang zangs mdog dpal ri'i dbyibs ltar mtshungs zhes dang lha khang chung yang skor lam phyi nang bar gsum du yod/ lhag par du o rgyan gling pa'i shangs khrag las bzhengs pa'i gu ru pad ma sam bha ba dang rta mgrin drag po tshar gcod kyi ldebs ris/ gsar bzhengs gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i thugs kur sngon gyi gzungs rang 'jags su gsol ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/dar rgyas chos gling / yar rje o rgyan gling nas nub ngos kyi ri ldebs su 'khor lam med stabs rkang thang mar chu tshod gcig ma zin tsam 'dzegs na dgon der 'byor/ dgon de ni thog mar drin chen sna tshogs rang grol gyis phyag btab gnang nas bla khag bzhi tsam byung / lnga pa gter bdag gling pa ni/yab gnubs chen gyi yang srid smyos ston gsang bdag chen po 'phrin las lhun grub dang / yum shel dkar rdo rje 'tsho'i sprul pa lha 'dzin dbyangs can sgrol ma gnyis la 1654lor sku bltams/ mtshan legs pa don grub tu gsol/ sku gzhon nu'i dus nas mkhyen dpyod yangs par gyur/ dgung po bco lnga par 'bras spungs su phebs nas rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po las rab tu byung /dgung lo nyi shu par slar yang rtse pho brang du phebs nas bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ bla chen mang po las dbang lung khrid gsum gsan/ g.ya' ma lung dang shel brag sogs nas zab gter bzhes pa'i mdzad 'phrin bskyangs/ slar yang gong sa lnga pa'i bka' bzhin pho brang po tā lar phebs te gter rdzas rnams spyan sngar bstar bas shin tu dgyes te gzengs bstod kyang chen po mdzad/ gra phyi thar pa
gling gi bdag thob kyang gnang bas 1676lor rmang btings pas gtsug lag khang ka ba brgyad cu gya bzhi thog rim gsum dang bcas pa smin grol gling dgon bzhengs gnang mdzad pas bu dgon de ma dgon du gyur/da lta dar rgyas chos gling 'du khang gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i dbus sman 'dam gyi mkhan slob chos gsum/ gter bdag gling pa'i sku brnyan sogs gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / gter bdag gling pa 'khrungs rjes kyi lho brag las shing shug pa zhig 'khrungs pa'i rtsa ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/sdings po che/ mtshan rgyas par 63sdings che don grub thog med gling 〉〉zhes zhu/ yar rje o rgyan gling nas 'khor lam brgyud spyi le lnga lhag tsam mar song na bde gling grong du 'byor/ de nas nub byang mtshams kyi ri ldebs su rkang thang mar chu tshod phyed tsam 'dzegs na dgon der slebs/ thog mar gnas der rgyal ba rgod tshang ba'i slob ma yang dgon zhu ba'i gdan sa zhig yod pa la/ rjes su 'brug pa pad ma dkar po'i dngos slob sems dpa' rin chen dpal bzang gis sku tshe'i stod la lcog gur phubs nas sgrub grwa btsugs/'dul ba'i bca' khrims shin tu dam po yod/ sku tshe'i smad char dgon de phyag btab gnang mdzad/ thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ni lcog grwa zhes pa de yin stabs rim bzhin bla ma'i mtshan la'ang lcog grwa rin po che zhes zhu/ sku phreng brgyad pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin chos kyi seng ges bshad grwa'ang 'dzugs gnang mdzad/da lta gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i 'du khang nang sngon sku phreng dang pos kong por bzhengs gnang mdzad pa'i gser zangs kyi rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyan zhig bar skabs nyams chag byung ba la nyams gso gnang ba zhig dang /gzhan yang sku brnyan gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/
snye mdo dgon/ sdings po che nas 'khor lam brgyud spyi le bdun brgyad tsam mar song na pad grong du 'byor zhing / pad grong nas spyi le drug bdun tsam 'khor lam spyir btang ba brgyud lung shur nang song na dgon de ri gdong zhig steng mjal rgyu yod/ sngon dgon der rdo snying dang 'dra ba zhig yod stabs snying rdo dgon zhes rdo de dus 'gyur ma byung bar du mjal rgyu yod/phyag 'debs pa po ni gter bdag gling pa yin zhes smin grol gling gi dgon lag yin/ da lta gsar bzhengs 'du khang nang gter bdag gling pa'i sku brnyan sogs rten sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/smin grol gling / mtshan rgyas par 88'og min o rgyan smin grol gling ji zhes zhu/ gra thang dgon nas shar du snum nag 'khor lam ded spyi le bzhi lnga tsam song na tshong 'dus grong du 'byor/ de nas nub ngos ri 'gram nas 'khor lam spyir btang ba brgyud lho ru spyi le brgyad dgu tsam song na thar pa gling grong dbus su dgon de chags yod/ dgon de ni rdo rje brag dang / smin grol gling /'phyongs rgyas dpal ri bcas lho khul gyi rnying dgon che ba gsum gyi ya gyal yin/thog mar gnas der klu med tshul khrims shes rab kyi dgon pa 66 thar pa gling nyagzhes pa zhig yod stabs de khul gyi grong la'ang thar pa gling zhes pa'i ming thogs/de rjes rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos thar pa gling gi bdag dbang gter bdag gling par gnang bas 1676lor smin gling dgon bzhengs 'go tshugs/ gtsug lag khang ka ba brgyad cu gya bzhi'i thog brtsegs gsum pa'i yang steng gsar zangs kyi gañji ra dang / li ma lha khang gi yangs steng gser zangs kyi rgyal mtshan gnyis/ phyi rol du 'khor sa brang khang dang bcas legs par grub/gong sa mchog nas dngul dkar gyi bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad thog
rtsegs ma'ang gsol stsal thob pa sogs rten gsum khyad par can bzhugs so gsol/ thog mar grwa grangs bzhi bcu skor nas rim bzhin sum brgyar nye ba byung / 1714lor gter bdag gling pa sku gshegs/ 1717lor jun gar dmag gis gsang sngags pho brang ma gtogs yongs rdzogs bshigs/ de rjes rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i dus slar yang rnying dgon thor zhig song rigs nyams gso dgos pa'i bka' shog ltar rim bzhin sngar ltar nyams gso gnang / gter bdag gling pa'i sku mched lo chen dharma shrīs rig gnas spyi la mdzad pa rgya chen spel gnang mdzad pa spyi/ bye brag sgra/ gso rig skar rtsis sogs la mkhas par gyur pa'i rgyun las sngon dgon der rig gnas kyi slob grwa zhig yod pa la phyogs mtha' khag nas ser skya ris med slob gnyer du phebs srol yod/da lta nyams gso gnang ba'i 'du khang dang gtsug lag khang nang rten gtsor thub dbang mthong grol thog rtsegs gsum ldan nye sras brgyad kyis bskor ba dang / gter bdag gling pas gter nas bzhes pa'i nang rten khaggzhan yang gsar bzhengs sku 'dra mang po sogs mjal rgyu yod/yang dgon de'i rgyab rir bsam gtan rtse dang / 'od gsal gling /theg mchog gling sogs jo dgon kha shas kyi rjes shul yang mjal rgyu yod/tshong 'dus grwa tshang / mtshan rgyas par 66mkhas mang bye ba 'dus pa'i rdzing bu 6 rje rdzing tshogs pag gzhes zhu/ smin grol gling nas mar lam spyi le brgyad dgu tsam yong na snum nag 'khor lam gyi lho zur nas tshong 'dus grong tsho'i dbus su dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ sngon dgon der lo ltar bod zla 8tshes 7nas nyin gsum tsam tshong 'dus tshogs pas 66tshong 'dus ji zhes pa'i ming de ltar byung / yang la las tshur 'dus zhes kyang zer/ de'ang rgyal mchog lnga pa
spyan snyun nas zhabs rim ji ltar bsgrubs kyang phan 'bras ma byung bar mthar dgon de'i srung ma bya khri spyan gcig bsten nas snyun gzhi dwangs stabs de nas bzung gzhung dgon min yang gra phyi mdo sgang gi mi ser tshang ma gzhung gi bka' ltar dgon de'i khral bsgrub dgos/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrīs tshogs pa sde bzhi btab gnang ba'i ya gyal yin/ dge 'dun zhal grangs dgu bcu lhag gis sa skya ngor lugs phyag bzhes gnang gi yod/ kha che paṇa chen gyis tshogs pa bzhi por sgrol ma gsung 'byon re dang / paṇa chen gyi 'dra brnyan rdza sku re gnang ba dgon 'di la'ang dus 'gyur ma byung bar du mjal rgyu yod/da lta 'du khang gtso bo nyams gso thub med kyang lcog khang nyams gso zhus pa'i nang rgyal mchog lnga pa'i phyag bzo bka' yi blon po bya khri spyan gcig gi sku brnyan gsar bzhengs dang / rten gtso thub sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/bsam yas dgon/ mtshan rgyas par 46 bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang 99zhes zhu/ gra phyi tshong 'dus tshogs pa nas spyi le gsum lhag tsam snum nag 'khor lo brgyud shar du song na 'khor lam 'og tu bsam yas gru kha yod/ de nas glog grur bsdad de chu tshod gnyis lhag song mtshams zur mkhar gru khar 'byor/ zur mkhar grong sne rdzogs mtshams ri 'bur zhig steng nam mkha' lding zhes gu ru'i zhabs rjes yod pa'i lha khang zhig gi rjes shul dang / rgyal pos gu rur sku phyag ma phul ba'i mthol bshags su bzhengs pa'i rdo yi mchod rten lnga po nyams gso zhus pa rnams mjal bzhin spyi le bcu gsum tsam 'khor lam brgyud song na bsam yas grong dbus su dgon de chags pa rgyang ring nas mjal thub/ bsam yas zhes pa ni thog mar rgyal pos gtsug lag khang de lta bu zhig bzhengs thub pa thugs su med kyang rjes su
gzhi rgya chen po de lta bu zhig 'grub stabs rgyal po'i dgongs pa las yas pas 88bsam yas 99zhes pa'i mtshan de ltar byung / de'ang chos rgyal gyis blon po rnams la zhang po rgya'i yul mthong ba'i mkhar zhig brtsig gam/ has po ri zangs kyis btums sam/ ka cu thang la khron pa 'dom dgu brgya dgu bcu byas pa brus sam/ lha khang bre tshad gang brtsig pa sogs gdam du bcug pas blon po 'gos sogs kyis lha khang bre tshad tsam zhig brtsig par zhus/ rgya khyon ni btsan po'i mda' rgyang gang gi tshad yin gsungs te spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad par chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan dang mkhan chen zhi ba tsho rnam gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang de bzhengs pa la lha srin sde brgyad kyis bzhengs ma bcug stabs slar yang slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas gdan drangs te gtsug lag khang maṇ+ḍal tshom bur dpe byas 'dra zhes pa de bzhengs/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan/ mkhan chen bho ti swa to/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas bcas mkhan slob chos gsum zhes pa'ang de nas byung / bod mi bdun mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho las rab tu byung ste sad mi bdun zhes su grags/ de nas bzung gtsug lag khang der bslab sdom srung ba'i dge 'dun yod pa ma zad rten dang brten pa bcas cha yongs su tshang bas bod du nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i dgon pa ang dang por gyur/ dgon de'i dbyibs ni dbu rtse rtsegs gsum yod pa la bod chos la dad pa rnams dga' ba skye ba'i phyir 'og khang bod lugs/ zhang po rgya yin pas bar khang rgya nag lugs/ chos kyi 'byung khungs rgya gar yin pas steng khang rgya gar lugs/ de'i nang chos rgyal gyi mnal lam du lung bstan byung ba ltar bsam yas has po ri nas gdan drangs pa'i rdo sku rang byon ma gtso bor gyur pa'i rten gsum khyad du 'phags pa dag bzhugs/ mtha' 'khor du sgo bzhi yod pa ni shar sgo 'jam dpal gling / lho sgo rta mgrin gling /nub sgo byams pa gling / byang sgo sems skyed gling bcas de dag re re la'ang lha
khang re/ da dung lcags ri'i phyi la'ang khams gsum gza' khang gling / dge rgyas li ma'i gling / bu tshal gser khang gling / phun tshogs 'od 'bar gling /zil gnon gling / bdud rtsi gling / gsang mdzod gling sogs gzhi rgya chen po de lta bu byung ba ni bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs klu mes sogs kyis chos 'chad nyan shin tu dar ba dang / jo bo a ti shas gnas der rgyud kyi po ti mang po gzigs/ rwa lo tsā bas nyams gso rgya cher mdzad/ sa skya'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis rab chung grwa tshang 'dzugs gnang mdzad/ gzhan yang sa dge/ bka' rnying dang bcas pa'i bla chen dang dad ldan mang po nyams gso rim par byas/ lhag tu rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtshos rang gi yab bsod nams dar rgyas ngo mar 'gan bskur te nyams gso gnang ba dang / de bzhin de mo rgyal thog dang / rta tshag rgyal thog/ rwa sgreng rgyal thog bcas kyi skabs la'ang nyams gso dang rgya skyed gnang yod/da lta nyams gso zhus pa'i gtsug lag khang nang jo bo byang chub chen po'i dbu la nyams chags byung ba las sngon gyi de rang dang der gsar bzhengs byang chub sems dpa' bcu yis bskor ba/ lha sras mu khri btsan po'i dad pa'i rten du bzhengs pa'i gu ru nga 'dra ma/ dge slong nam mkha'i snying po'i phyag bzo ba kong las grub pa'i gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje sogs dang / gzhan yang mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i dbu thod/ gu ru rin po ches gung thang la la bzhag gnang ba'i zhabs rjes g.yon ma/ lha 'dre bka' thang / stod lung lha chu bton gnang ba'i phyag 'khar/ gu ru'i dbu skra li'u bdun bzhugs pa'i g.yu yi gzu 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag lo chen be+e ro tsa na dang / paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra'i phyag 'khar/ da dung bsam yas lcog tu gu ru'i phyag bzo srin bu'i rgyal po nam mkha' mgrin bcu'i pags pa las bzos pa'i pe har rgyal po'i sku brnyan/'dzam gling srog bdag gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum/ seng 'bag smug chung sogs
rten rnying dang / gsar bzhengs mchod rten dkar dmar sngo nag sogs kyang mjal rgyu yod/g.ya' ma lung / bsam yas nas byang shar du spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le bco lnga tsam song na g.ya' ri sgang grong 'dabs su 'byor zhing / g.ya' ri sgang zhes pa ni g.ya' ma lung gi ri 'dir zangs kyi g.ya' 'gos pa ltar yod pas g.ya' ri dang / de'i 'dabes kyi sding khar gnas pa'i grong la g.ya' ri sgang zhes thogs/ der spang gshongs tshe ril na ga zhes par bzhugs khri zhig yod pa rgyal ba lnga pa'i bzhugs khri yin zer/ de nas grong de'i mdun rir 'khor lam med stabs rkang thang mar chu tshod gcig lhag tsam 'dzegs na g.ya' ma lung ri khrod du 'byor/ ri khrod de ni gu rus bsam yas bzhengs grub rjes chos rgyal khri srong gi sku tshe tshe sgrub mdzad skabs tshe dpag med zhal gzigs/ gnas der gter bdag gling pas tshe sgrub lo gnyis gnang /rgyal ba lnga pas kyang tshe sgrub gnang ste lo gcig bzhugs pa sogs bod kyi tshe sgrub gnang sa'i sgrub phug gtso bo de yin zhing / tshe dbang tshe sgrub kyi lugs kyang 'di nas dar ba yin gsungs/ 'on kyang gu rus tshe dbang 'grub rjes bdud blon gyis rgyal po gdan ma drangs stabs gu ru thugs khros pa'i tshul gyis tshe ril 'og gi na steng du bshos pas tshe ril na ga zhes pa'ang de ltar byung / ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis gu rur snyigs dus sems can la dad pa'i rten zhig yod par zhu zhus pas sgrub phug gi 'og tsam na tshe chu zhig yod pa de gnang ba yin gsungs/ sngon der tshe sgrub gnang mkhan smin grol gling nas grwa pa brgyad/bsam yas nas gcig bcas rgyun bzhugs dang / rgyud grwa stod smad nas lo ltar res mos kyis tshe sgrub gnang srol yod pa bcas dang / da dung de'i g.yas su be+e ror ye shes kyi spyan 'khrungs pa'i sgrub phug dang / rje 'bangs
nyer lnga'i phug sogs yod/de nas bsam yas su mar yong ba'i lam bar du brag dmar brag tshang zhes par khri srong gi 'khrungs khang yod/mchims phu/ bsam yas nas spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le dgu tsam byang shar ngos su song na mchims phu'i ri 'dabs su 'byor/nanamachims phu nya zhes pa ni ri de'i dbu rtser gu ru'i sgrub phug phying pa'i gur 'dra ba zhig yod pa la 66phying gur :: zhes pa'i sgra las mchims phu zhes pa'i sgrar 'gyur gsungs/ mchims phu'i ri 'debs su 'khor lam med pas rkang thang mar chu tshod gcig tsam song na rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i phyag bzhes gnang sa dben rtsa zhes pa'i jo dgon dang / de nas rim bzhin pad ma kha phye ba lta bu'i sgrub phug brgya dang brgyad/ chu mig brgya dang brgyad/ tshogs gzhong brgya dang brgyad/ dur khrod brgya dang brgyad bcas yod pa las gtso bo'i sgrub phug bzhi ni gsang chen me tog phug klong chen phug rta mgrin phug mtsho rgyal phug bcas zangs mdog dpal ri'i dbyibs 'dra ba'i g.yas g.yon du yod/ de nas brag dmar ki'u tshang du slebs pas de ni sngon 'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen gyi khongs yin/ der gu rur sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi zhal gzigs thob/ de nas o rgyan rtser yo rgyan phug nang lha lcam pad ma sras dgongs pa rdzogs sa yin/ gzhan yang mtsho rgyal gzim phug a tsa ra sa le'i brag phug de'i 'og tu gu rus klu dam la btags sa'i sgrub phug karma pa sku phreng gsum pa'i sgrub phug nang gter nas bzhes pa'i mchod rten sogs mjal rgyu yod/gsang sngags chos 'khor gling / bsam yas gru kha nas spyi le lnga tsam snum nag 'khor lam brgyud song na rnam sras gling gzhis gar slebs/
thog mar sa de'i ming la mon 'khar zhes zer zhing / de rjes rnam sras gling gzhis ka de rnam sras kyi pho brang la dpe blangs nas bskrun stabs rnam sras gling zhes thogs/ sngon gzhis ka der rnam sras rta bdag brgyad kyi mchod rten phyi ru brgyad dang / nang du brgyad yod/ nang gi brgyad po ni sku rgyu tsan dan las grub cing sgo khyim gser gyi babs las brgyan yod zer/ da lta nang rten de dag med kyang gzhis ka rnying pa 'gying nger gnas yod/ de nas shar gyi ri 'bur steng du spyi le gsum tsam song na gsang sngags chos 'khor gling dgon par 'byor/ dgon de ni thog mar spyan lnga lha srin ral pas phyag btab gnang mdzad/ de rjes zhwa dmar sku thog bcu gcig pa dkon mchog gar dbang rgya mtsho dang / rdo brag pad ma 'phrin las rnam sras gling gzhis kur 'khrungs/rje gar dbang rgya mtshos dgon de rgya skyed gnang / rje de nyid rgyal mchog lnga pa'i dus lha sar chu bsgyur te chu 'gog zhabs rim gnang bar phebs par mdzad 'phrin chen po byung ste gra phyi thang grong gzhis ka chos thebs su gnang skabs de bas dar rgyas byung ste dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu so lnga tsam zin/sngon rten gtsor dgon de'i rgyab rir mkhas 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal bzhugs myong ba'i sre mong ri jun gar bas gtor rjes de'i 'og brag rong nas bsgrugs pa'i kurma pa shrī'i sku rdul mi bzhes pa zhig dang bal bzos pa so'i sgrol dkar gsung 'byon/ 'ja' khra bsher dpangs sogs dus 'gyur ma byung bar du mjal rgyu yod/da lta gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i 'du khang nang mkhan slob chos gsum gyi sku brnyan gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/ yang de'i la rgyab bying gi phur o dkar brag ces gu ru'i sgrub phug yod pas mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang gu ru sre mong la sprul te phebs 'ong gnang gi yod zer/

pho brang nas yar klungs phyogs su 'khor lam brgyud spyi le nyi shu rtsa gnyis tsam song na chos sde gong grong dbus su dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de ni thog mar rwa lo tsā bas dus rabs bcu gcig pa tsam la phyag btab gnang mdzad/de'ang rwa lo tsā ba dwags kong phyogs su phebs skabs yar lha sham por gangs babs nas phebs ma thub pas ma tshad rwa lo'i chibs rta chibs drel sogs kyang shi/ de nas rwa los 'jigs byed srung 'khor sgom gnang bas yar lha sham po'i gangs ri'ang gsum cha gcig tsam bzhur stabs yar lha sham po rwa lo'i sku mdun du bcar nas bshags pa phul/ dgon de bzhengs rgyu dang / phyis 'gro ba sems can la mi gnod rgyu'i khas len zhus pa sogs thog mar bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa yin pa la/ phyis su rgyal mchog lnga pa'i dus phyi gling bcu gsum zhes dge lugs par bsgyur gnang mdzad/ dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang lnga bcu tsam zin/ de nas rim bzhin rwa lo'i rnam sprul dge slong char ka sku thog dang po nas bzung da lta'i bstan 'dzin lung rtogs 'phrin las chos 'phags bar sku thog nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung / de rjes rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum dus da lta'i dgon de slar yang gsar bzhengs mdzad/ sngon rten gtso rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dang / dus gsum sangs rgyas thog so gnyis ldan sogs rten sku mang po mjal rgyu yod/da lta nyams gso zhus pa'i 'du khang nang sngon gyi rten gtso de dag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / ldebs ris rnying ma mang po mjal rgyu yod/da dung chos sde 'og ces rgyal ba lnga pa'i dus phyag btab gnang ba'i dgun kha bzhugs gnas shig kyang yod/ gnyis kur mdo sngags gnyis ka phyag bzhes gnang zhing / yig cha ni 'bras blo gling grwa tshang gi yin/ mdun ri ngo mtshar can ni yar lha sham po'i sgo srung ngam ri rgyud dang / 'di nas yar stod brag la 'dzegs pa'i 'go tshugs pa yin/
g.ya' bzang dgon/ mtshan rgyas par 64g.ya' bzang dga' ldan bsam gtan gling nya zhes zhu/ chos sde gong nas spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le bdun brgyad tsam song na yar lha sham po'i ri 'dabs g.ya' bzang grong gi nub ri'i ldebs yar lha sham po'i kha khrod du dgon de mjal rgyu yod/dgon de ni zwa ra ba skal ldan ye shes seng ge'i dngos slob rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa dgung lo so brgyad la phebs pa spyi lo 1206lor dgon de phyag btab nas rgyun bzhugs mdzad/ tshogs pa nyis stong brgyad brgya tsam byung gsungs/mthar sku 'ja' lus su phebs nas sku gdung ring bsrel mkha' 'gros spyan drangs/ chos rgyal srong btsan gyi rnam sprul yin par grags/ sku phreng rim pa dgu tsam byung ba la dgu pa lcang grong spyi phyag ste sprul sku 'phrin las chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes su grags/ g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud pa'i srol gtod po'ang rje 'di yin/ sngon dgon der gser zangs kyi rgyal ba shākya mu rna mi tshad ma dang /jo bo mi skyod rdo rje sogs rten ji snyed cig bzhugs su gsol yod/da lta gsar bzhengs 'du khang nang sngon gyi sku de dag gi sku tshab 'jim sku mang po gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod la/ sngon rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pas bod kyi khri dpon gnang skabs kyi srung ma mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang / lha tsan ḍi ka sogs kyi sku brnyan yang mjal rgyu yod/yang de'i phu la 'khor lam med stabs rkang thang mar chu tshod gsum lhag tsam phyin na gangs nub ces pa'i jo dgon zhig yod pa der ma cig lab sgron gyi sras sgam po thos yon bsam grub kyi sgrub phug byin can zhig dang / gu ru rin po che dang / rgyal ba klong chen pa sogs kyi sgrub phug kyang mjal rgyu yod/rgya bza' khang / mtshan gzhan la 66brgya bza' lha khang ji zhes zhu/ pho
54 sno gdong rdzong khongs/—brang grong nas lho nub ngos yar lha sham bu'i chu thon nas spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le gnyis tsam song na ze stod grong gi stod du lha khang de mjal rgyu yod/66ze stod ji ces pa ni sngon bla ma g.yung drung khro rgyal zhu ba der bzhugs shing 88lung pa 'di gzengs su thon pa zhig 'ong ji zhes gsungs pa las ze stod ces pa'i ming de'i zur chags/ lha khang de ni chos rgyal mes ag tshom gyi btsun mo khri srong lde btsan gyi yum ngang tshul rgyal mo ste gyim shing kong jo'am cing dreng kong jo'i bzhugs sa yin cing / sngon der chos rgyal mes ag tshom gyi phyag bzokhyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gi sku zhig yod pa de nyams chags byung ba'i sa de rang gis bzhengs pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gi sku brnyan zhig lha khang rnying pa'i nang du mjal rgyu yod/ sngon lha khang der bkra shis chos sde nas sku gnyer re btang gnang dgos/rgya bza' khang gi 'og tu 46'bum rten chen po 99zhes pa'i 'bum pa'i shul zhig yod pas bod zla 4tshes 15za ba shar skabs 'bum pa der grib so med zer/bkra shis chos sde/ mtshan rgyas par 68yar klungs bkra shis chos sde 99zhes zhu/ khra 'brug nas bkra shis thog med bar spyi le bzhi tsam dang / bkra shis thog med nas bkra shis zam pa thon te spyi le gcig tsam song na bkra shis zhol pa grong gi ri 'gram du dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ 66bkra shis zhol pa ji zhes pa ni bkra shis chos sde'i zhol du chags pas bkra shis zhol pa zhes thogs/dgon de ni thog mar mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros te rje red mda' bas phyag btab gnang mdzad/ de rjes mtshar chen blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad pa rgya cher bskyangs/ da lta 'tsho bzhugs byams pa blo gsal bar sku phreng dgu tsam byung /sa skya mtshar lugs yin/ dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu tsam zin/ sngon
dgon der rten gtso gser zangs kyi thub dbang thog brtsegs gnyis ldan dang rje red mda' ba'i sku brnyan sogs yod pa la/ da lta gsar bzhengs 'du khang nang thub dbang gi 'jim sku dang / sngon gyi rje red mda' ba'i sku 'dra'i sku stod de rang la sku smad gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/gzhan yang yar klungs bkra shis zhol pa zhes pa'i lha mo 'bag dkar po'i 'byung gnas kyang yul der yin/ sngon grub thob thang stong gnas der phebs skabs/ yul 'di la bkra shis thog med dang / bkra shis zam pa/bkra shis chos sde/ bkra shis rtse/ bkra shis zhol pa bcas bkra shis lnga tshang bas 'dir lha mo btsugs gsungs nas thog mar a ce lha mo yul de nas 'go btsugs/ rgyal mchog lnga pa 'phyongs rgyas su 'khrungs rjes rten 'brel zhu skabs kyang lha mo de 'khyab/ sngon nor gling zho ston du bcar skabs kyang lha mo kun gyi 'byung gnas yin zer ang dang por 'khyab dgos/ 'on kyang rjes su 'phyongs rgyas spun bdun zhes pa'i lha mo'i 'bag gi mig yar lta red ces sngon du 'khyab srol yang byung /ras chung phug bkra shis chos sde nas spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le gnyis ma zin tsam bskyod na ras chung phug pa grong gi lho ngos su ras chung phug dgon pa mjal rgyu yod/ nanaras chung phug nya ces pa ni dgon der gtso bo ras chung ba'i sgrub phug yod stabs ras chung phug ces zer zhing yar klungs phug gsum zhes pa'i ya gyal yang yin/ thog mar ras chung ba'i sgrub phug tsam yin pa la rjes su ras chung ba'i rnam sprul gtsang smyon he ru ka byon te mdzad pa rgya cher bskyangs/ sngon dus 'gyur gong dgon der dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu tsam dang / 'du khang a ma zhes dang / rtse pho brang / gtsug lag khang /ma ṇi lha khang sogs gzhi khyon ha cang chen po yod/
da lta nyams gso zhus pa'i phug pa'i nang gu ru dang / ras chung / mi la/gtsang smyon sogs kyi 'dra sku dang / lhag par du ras chung ba'i zhabs rjes dang / mi la'i phyag 'khar/ gzhan yang rang byon sna tshogs bcas mjal rgyu yod/bairo phug ras chung phug nas 'khor lam spyir btang ba brgyud spyi le gnyis tsam phyin na pad rong grong gi shar ri'i ldebs su sgrub phug de mjal rgyu yod/ sgrub phug de ni yar klungs phug gsum gyi ya gyal zhig kyang yin/ pad grong zhes pa ni sngon shel brag gi 'og tu pad sgang zhes pa'i grong zhig yod pa dang / de'i 'og tu chags pa'i grong la pad grong zhes pa'i ming de thogs zer/sgrub phug der be+e ro tsa na lo dgu bzhugs/ be+e ro snye mor 'khrungs nas rgya gar du phebs/ de rjes sgrub phug der bzhugs nas lo drug tsam song skabs/ tshe chu 'bum par bzhugs pa'i gu ru rin po ches mkhyen nas der phebs te sgrub rtags 'gran gnang mdzad/ thog mar gu rus brag phug nang gi brag thams cad mar 'bebs gnang bas/ bai ros phyag g.yas pa dang zhabs g.yon mas phar phud/ dbus yar skyor gnang ba bcas kyi rang byon yang yod pas/ gu rus 6( be+e ro tsa na o rgyan dngos dang mnyam jig gsungs pa'ang de nas byung gsungs/ da dung sgrub phug nang chos bka' 'gyur gyi rtsig pa'i rang byon dang /dam can zhal 'bag gi rang byon yang mjal rgyu yod/ brag phug gi 'og tu grong zhig yod pa la 66rogs pa rtse ji zhes zer/ de ltar zer dgos don ni be+e ros 66nga lo dgu 'dir sgrub pa rgyag skabs rogs pa rtse dra byas byung ji zhes gsungs pas rogs pa rtse pa zhes pa de ltar byung / sngon brag phug de shin tu btsan po yod/ rjes su nyams chags byung rjes da lta mjal bde po yod/
god thang 'bum pa/ mtshan gzhan la 44dgon thang 'bum pa'ang ji zer/ be+e ro phug nas lho nub mtshams kyi zhing thang du spyi le gcig tsam sar rgod thang grong zhes par 'bum pa de mjal rgyu yod/ 'bum pa de ni yar klungs rten gsum nang tshan gyi 'bum pa gcig yin/ rgod thang zhes pa ni sngon tshong dpon nor bu bzang po 'dir phebs nas chibs rta chad nas bzhugs pa'i skabs shig na/ chibs rta'i steng du rgod cig babs par tshong dpon rnam rtog 'khrungs nas de mar rgod la mda' 'phangs pas rgod la phog rgod kyis mda' khur bzhin shel brag rgod tshang du song yang mda' 'khur te rgod tshang nang 'gro mi thub pa sku gnyer gyis mthong nas mda' tshur 'then pas rgod nang du thar/ mda' de shel brag brag phug gi steng du gzer nas bzhag dus nam zhig na tshong dpon nor bu bzang po shel brag tu phebs skabs mda' de gzigs pas nges 'byung drag po skyes te sdig bshags kyi ched du rgod thang 'bum pa bzhengs/ tshong dpon gyi bla g.yu bya rna tso tsam zhig yod pa de'ang 'bum pa'i nang 'bul gnang mdzad gsung / yang gsung srol gzhan zhig la mnga' bdag lha sde'i dus su rgod thang gra mig bya ba der rgod thang 'bum pa'i nang bzhugs rje btsun sgrol ma'i sprul pa ne tso mas nyar ba'i bla g.yu dang /ring srel sogs bzhugs pa'i mchod rten chung ngu zhig bzhengs te smri tis rab gnas mdzad/ de rjes de'i phyir 'bum pa chen po de byung zhes kyang gsung /da lta gsar du bzhengs pa'i lha khang nang sngon tshong dpon gyi rta 'dogs sa'i rdo phur dang / rten sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba/ sngon gyi 'bum pa'i shul du 'bum pa gsar bzhings gnang ba bcas mjal rgyu yod/che chu 'bum pa/ rgod thang 'bum pa nas 'khor lam brgyud spyi le
bzhi lnga tsam song na btsan thang grong gi lam steng du 'bum pa de mjal rgyu yod/'bum pa de'ang yar klungs rten gsum nang tshan gyi 'bum pa zhig yin/'bum pa de ni sngon dus skabs shig na bod kyi mi mang po shi ba btsun mo cog ro bza' sgron gyis gu ru rin po cher de'i zlog thabs zhus par gu rus gnas der dong mi tshad dgu drus te thog mar bod mir byang chub kyi sems skyes ched spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa dang / de'i steng nad gdon las sgrol ched rje btsun sgrol ma/ de'i steng gu ru snang srid zil gnon dang / de'i steng 'bum pa zhig bzhengs dgos gsungs pa ltar bzhengs pa yin gsungs/ sngon tshes bco lngar tshe chu babs pa'i rdo de ni gu rus bsam yas g.ya' ma lung du tshe chu sho sa'i rdo de yin kyang da lta mjal rgyu med/da lta bang rim 'og ma nas nyams gso zhus pa'i 'bum pa'i nang shel brag gi nang rten chos gos nyi zer ma zhes pa dang / dbu skra 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/ mchod rten der skor ba bsags na tshe 'phel zhing nad gdon 'joms zhes zer/shel brag mtshan gzhan la 66yar klungs shel brag nya ces kyang zer/tshe chu 'bum pa nas rkang thang mar chu tshod bzhi tsam nub ngos kyi shel brag gi rir 'dzegs na shel brag dgon du 'byor/ de nas bar do'i 'phrang lam zhes brag skas brgyud rim bzhin song na gu ru'i sgrub phug tu 'byor/ de'ang yar klungs shel brag dang / brag yer pa/ bsam yas mchims phu bcas ni bod kyi brag chen gsum zhes dang / lha sa dkyil 'khor mthil dang / bsam yas/khra 'brug bcas ni chos 'khor gsum yin zhes zer/ shel brag phug tu gu ru rin po che lo gsum bzhugs nas sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi zhi khro'i lha tshogs thams cad zhal gzigs pa brag la stims/ sgrub phug nang spyan ras gzigs

68 'phyongs rgyas rdzong khongs/——ri bo bde chen/ mtshan rgyas par 66'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen nyagzhes zhu/ 'phyongs rgyas zhol gyi rgyab rir sngon gyi dgon rnying gi gyang gog dang /'phyongs rgyas 'phying ba stag rtse'i rdzong shul/ gsar du bzhengs pa'i ri bo bde chen dgon sogs mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de ni thog mar 'phyongs rgyas sde pa za hor gyi rigs rgyud rdo rje tshe brtan rnam rgyal bya ba dang / gtsang pa'i sde pa 'khrug rtsod chen po byung / rjes su sde pa de gnyis gzhi mthun byung ste rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dus gtsang bkra shis lhun po bzhengs par 'phyongs rgyas nas rdo bzo dang shing bzo mang po btang gnang ba dang / de nas lo bcu song mtshams mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gi dngos slob nyi khri 'dzin pa blo gros dpal bzang gis dgon de phyag btab gnang mdzad/ gtsang gi rdo bzo dang shing bzo mang po song ste ri bo bde chen gtsug lag khang ni bkras lhun gtsug lag khang dang dbyibs 'dra zer/ de nas sku thog bzhi pa 'bras blo gling gi sku zhabs thog med rin po che bar byung / sngon dge 'dun zhal grangs drug brgya lhag tsam gyis dge lugs sngags chog phyag bzhes gnang gi yod/ sngon gyi 'du khang rnying par ka ba bdun cu yod pa'i nang gi rten gtsor gser zangs kyi byams pa mthong grol thog so gcig tsam nye sras brgyad kyis bskor ba sogs rten sku khyad du 'phags pa du ma mjal rgyu yod/da lta gsar bzhengs 'du khang ni sngon rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i gzim shag gi shul du yin cing de'i nang rje yab sras thog so nyis ldan dang /rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen nyi khri 'dzin pa sogs kyi sku brnyan mjal rgyu yod/gzhan yang 'phyongs rgyas grong dbus su rgyal ba lnga pa'i 'khrungs khang dang / rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i yab chen bsod nams dar rgyas kyi
'khrungs khang sogs kyang mjal rgyu yod/spyan g.yas/ mtshan rgyas par 66yar rgyal phu thang spyan g.yas dgon ji zhes zhu/ 'phyongs rgyas rdzong nas spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud nub ngos su spyi le bcu drug tsam rgya sman nang zhes par song na spyan g.yas grong dbus su dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de ni thog mar gter ston grwa pa mngon shes kyis spyi lo 1012lor phyag btab gnang mdzad/ spyod 'jug gi bshad grwa rgya chen spel gnang nas dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga brgya tsam zin gsungs/ de rjes skabs shig nyams te dbon dgon du'ang gyur/ de rjes bka' brgyud pa'i mkhan chen g.ya' bzang rtseg pas gan m+bha la rdo rtsigs las grub pa'i gtsug lag khang thog so bzhi bskrun/ thog me'i 'du khang ni da lta'i rung khang de yin gsungs/nang rten sngar yod steng sman 'dam gyi rgyal ba byams pa dang / g.yas g.yon du lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang g.ya' bzang brtsegs pa'i sku gdung bzhugs pa'i gser zangs kyi gdung rten gnyis sogs bzhugs gsungs/ de rjes slar yang dge dgon du gyur/ spyan g.yas zhes pa ni sngon dgon de'i rten gtso nyan thos shā ri'i bu'i spyan g.yas pa bzhugs pa'i shar li'i bka' gdams mchod rten thog brtseg gnyis ldan can zhig bzhugs stabs dgon ming la'ang spyan g.yas zhes thogs/ da dung yar klungs rten gsum gyi nang tshan sku rgyu lha'i k+ṣim las grub pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen zla ba'i sku brnyan zhig yod pa de ni/ sngon dza ri kun bzang ste seng gdong ma zhes pa'i ri 'dabs su bde gshegs thang zhes par ra rdzi zhig gi ra dkar po zhig rtag tu bor brlags 'gro gi yod pas nyin gcig de'i rjes bsnyegs te song bas/ bde gshegs thang du sman bla bde gshegs brgyad gso sbyong tshugs pa'i skabs dang 'khel/ra rdzis de dbus zhwa mo g.yugs pas gzhan rnams nam mkhar gshegs kyang
mtshan legs dang / rin chen zla ba/ sman pa'i rgyal po bcas la mi grib phog ste phebs ma thub par de dag so so sku brnyan du gyur stabs ra rdzis de gsum gdan drangs nas rin chen zla ba spyan g.yas su phul/ mtshan legs rol khang du phul/ sman rgyal yar klungs lha rur phul/ ra dkar po'ang lha rur thims/ra rdzi srong btsan gyi bang sor thims pa bcas kyi shod srol yod/ da lta lha ri sman rgyal yum bu brla mkhar du bzhugs pa las gzhan rnams med/ da dung shing tā la'i lo ma'i steng du bris pa'i rgya dpe mang po dang / jo bo rje'i dbu zhwa/phag gru'i zhabs rjes/ dge slong ma pad mo'i zhabs can sogs nang rten dang rten sku ji snyed bzhugs/da lta nyams gso zhus pa'i 'du khang nang gsar bzhings sman 'dam gyi byams pa thog so gnyis ldan gyi g.yas su mar me mdzad dang / g.yon du shākya thub pa/ 'du khang nang rje yab sras gsum gyi sku brnyan/ gzhan yang ldebs ris rnying ma mang po sogs mjal rgyu yod/da dung dgon de dang nye bar ri bo bde chen gyi khongs 66rol khang ji zhes pa'i lha khang dang / yang dgon de'i dbyar gnas bzhugs yul dga' ldan dgon nam/ bsam gtan byang chub gling zhu ba gsang phu phyag 'debs po grong chen blo gros rgya mtshos phyag btab gnang ba'i ri khrod gcig kyang yod/ sngon gnas der grong chen blo gros rgya mtsho'i thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs pa'i rje tsong kha pa'i sku brnyan byin can zhig dus 'gyur ma byung bar du mjal ba yin/lam rim dgon/ mtshan rgyas par 66lam rim skal bzang dga' tshal theg pa chen po 99 zhes zhu/ 'phyongs rgyas rdzong nas spyi le bcu bdun tsam 'khor lam brgyud mar yong dus sbas sne zhes pa'i grong nas nub ngos su spyi le
bzhi tsam 'khor lam spyir btang ba brgyud phyin na lam rim grong dbus su dgon de mjal thub/ thog mar dgon de yul de'i phu ru bar snang zhes par sde pa 'phyos pa chos rgyal pas sbyin bdag byas te thar ma chos mdzad rgyud pa tshul bzang par grags pas btab/ rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob gzhon nu sangs rgyas kyis lam rim gsungs pas dgon ming du lam rim zhes chags/de rjes dgon der me skyon byung rjes rwa sgreng mkhan thog lnga pa blo gros phun tshogs zhu bas da lta'i dgon pa chags yul der gnas spos gnang / se ra sngags pa grwa tshang dang phyag bzhes mtshungs/ dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bcu med lnga tsam bar 'phel/ sngon 'du khang ka ba sum cu dang / gtsang khang ka ba drug bcas kyi nang rten gtso sman 'dam gyi rgyal ba byams pa thog brtseg gnyis ldan dang / g.yas g.yon du dus gsum sangs rgyas/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ gzhan yang mkhan chen blo gros phun tshogs kyi yum gyi dbu thod nang 'jam dbyangs kyi rang byon gsal ba zhig dang / rje bkra shis du kha ma bzhugs pa'i rje yab sras gsum sogs mjal rgyu yod/da lta gsar bzhengs 'du khang nang gtso bo rgyal ba byams pa sngon gyi sku tshad de lhag dang / g.yas su jo bo rje/ g.yon du rje rin po che/ sman bla'i lha khang nang gu ru'i sku/ gzhan yang bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/dgon de nas phu ru spyi le gnyis tsam gyi sa la sde chen zhes par 66bkra shis bde chen ji zhes rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho sku mtshams su bzhugs myong ba zhig dang / de'i kha sprod du pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi ri khrod/ dgon de'i gsham du bka' brgyud pa'i jo dgon zhig gi rjes shul sogs mjal rgyu yod/
zangs ri rdzong /66zangs ri nya zhes pa ni sngon gyi zangs ri rdzong chags sa'i ri de zangs kyi mdog ltar 'dra bas zangs ri zhes de'i ming rang 'jags su bzhag stabs da lta'ang 66zarngas ri rdzong jig zhes zer/ da lta'i rdzong gi gnas yul kyang sngon gyi zangs ri rdzong gnas yul dang nye ba'i spyi le gcig tsam gyi sar chags yod/rdzong de'i spyi'i rgya khyon spyi le ngos snyom gru bzhi ma 2638dang / sa zhing mu'u khri 2 3 mi 'bor khri 1 4 cha snyom rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi le 4000tsam gyis mtho ba'i sa babs yin pa bcas so//gdan sa mthil/ rtsed thang nas zangs ri'i phyogs su 'khor lam brgyud spyi le sum cu tsam song na klu khang gru kha'i dpyang zam brgyud da lta'i zangs ri rdzong gnas yul su 'byor/ zangs ri rdzong nas phyag 'tshal shar zhes pa'i la rgyab nas rkang thang mar chu tshod gsum tsam song na gdan sa mthil du 'byor/ dgon de ni spyi lo 1158lor mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i dngos slob 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa sku thog dang po rdo rje rgyal po'am byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab gnang mdzad/ theg chen gling dang / 'phel rgyas gling /mdzad rgyas gling bcas grwa tshang gsum dang / tshogs chen gcig gzhan yang shar gling brgya dang nub gling stong zhes dge 'dun zhal grangs khri phrag bco brgyad dang / bla ma lnga brgya tsam bar 'phel rgyas byung zhes gsungs/ rje phag mo gru pa sku thog dang po rdo rje rgyal po'am byang chub rgyal mtshan nas sku thog bco lnga tsam byung / phag gru sde srid sku thog dang po byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis

1354lor sa skyar dmag drangs te sa skya'i dbang sgyur mjug sgril ba bzos nas phag mo gru pas bod khams dbang du bsgyur zhes zer/ rje sgam po ba gshegs rjes phag gru dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgur mthar rtsa'i grong mdar grong la phag mo zhes dang / gru la phag gru zer ba/ yi dam phag mo bzhugs pa'i gnas la gdan sa mthil zhes pa'i dgon pa phyag btab pas phag gru zhes pa yul ming bla mar thogs/ sku thog bco lnga pa nas sku'i yang srid ma byon stabs rgyal srid chos srid rgyal ba lnga pas bzhes zhes gsungs/ sngon dgon der gser zangs kyi thub pa lha yul ma zhes gsung 'byon ma mi tshad dang / gser zangs kyi sangs rgyas kyi sku thog so gnyis ldan can brgyad/ gser zangs kyi rje phag mo gru pa rim byon gyi gdung rten brgyad/ bka' brgyud bla rabs rnams kyi 'jim sku mi tshad ma/ hu ma rgyal pos dmag gis bshags par phul ba'i gser rjen rdung ma'i ka phan mtho tshad spyi khre gsum dang / zheng tshad spyi skar bzhi bcu tsam byas pa bdun/ 'brug gi rwa co/ sangs rgyas chos 'phags kyi tshems/bcom ldan 'das kyi tshems/ phag gru'i dbu zhwa'i steng mu tig mthe bong tsam dang / lha khang rer bse ru'i rwa re/ da dung rgyal ba phebs rim bzhin 'bul gnang mdzad pa'i gser gyi me long bdun bcas la sogs pa mjal rgyu yod/da lta grwa tshang 'phel rgyas gling nyams gso zhus pa'i nang ma ṇi'i rang byon dang / phag gru'i bzhugs khri/ tshogs chen ltag gi phag gru'i gzim sbug nang gsar bzhengs sman 'dam gyi phag gru'i 'dra sku sogs mjal rgyu yod/zangs ri mkhar dmar/ da lta'i zangs ri rdzong nas shar du spyi le gnyis tsam song na rje bzhugs grong ste rje rin po che bzhugs myong ba'i grong gi ri steng du dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de ni thog mar ma cig lab sgron gyis spyi lo 1145lor phyag btab gnang mdzad/ mkhar dmar zhes pa ni skyob
ston bsod nams bla mas ma cig lab sgron la brag rdo zhig chur bskur gnang ste 'di gang du 'khur yang der khyod kyis dgon pa zhig thobs gsungs par/brag rdo de dgon de'i mdun gyi gtsang po'i nang du 'khar stabs de dang nye ba'i ri steng du da lta'i mkhar dmar dgon de phyag btab gnang mdzad/ de nas ma cig lab sgron gyis gcod kyi srol chen po gtod/ nang chos thams cad rgya gar nas bod du dar ba yin kyang / bod chos rgya gar la phar dar ba ni ma cig gi gcod rgyun tsam yin gsungs/ pha rgyud thabs kyi rgyud pa pha dam pa sangs rgyas dang / ma rgyud shes rab kyi rgyud pa ma cig lab sgron yin zhes zhu/ ma cig mkhar du ma byon gong e chung glang lung zhes par yab thos pa bha ḍa dang / zhal sbyor gyi tshul bstan nas sras che ba don grub glang lung du sku 'khrungs pa sogs rim bzhin sras sros gsum byung ba kun gyi mdzad pa rgya cher bskyangs/ rgya gar sogs phyogs mtha' mang po nas chos zhu ba 'bum phrag tsam zin skad/ thog mar btsun dgon yin kyang rjes su chu 'gram gyi dga' sgra dgon chus 'jig rjes der spos pas grwa dgon du gyur/ dgon de'i phyag bzhes ni gcod rgyun ma cig tsam las dge ldan pa phyag bzhes gnang ba red/ dge 'dun zhal grangs sum cu tsam yod/ sngon rten gtsor ma cig gi sku bzhur 'bul zhus pa'i ring bsrel bre gang tsam bzhugs pa'i 'dra sku dang / grub chen thos pa bha ḍa dang /pha dam pa sangs rgyas/ sras sros bcas kyi 'dra sku la sogs pa'i rten dang brten pa yod/da lta nyams gso zhus pa'i 'du khang nang ston pa'i sku dang / steng du gsar bzhengs ma cig gi 'dra sku'i thugs gar ma cig gi dbu skra phul ba/gzhan yang sngar gyi sku 'dra'i tshab tu 'jim sku mang po gsar bzhengs gnang yod pa/ da dung 'og tu ma cig gi gzim phug nang ma cig gi 'dra sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/
dgon de'i gsham du rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i pho brang dang / phu ru 'phying ri khrod/ gter chung ri khrod/ jo dgon dga' ldan lha lding / se dgon o rgyan phug phra tshal zhes pa sogs kyi rjes shul yang mjal rgyu yod/rdzing phyi/ mtshan rgyas par 66rdzing phyi dga' ldan byams pa gling 99zhes zhu/ zangs ri rdzong nas shar ngos su 'khor lam brgyud spyi le bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam song na 'ol dga' rdzong shul rnying par 'byor/ 'ol dga' zhes pa ni yul de'i lho ngos su srid pa'i lha chen 'ol de gong rgyal gnas pa'i gangs ri bstar chags su yod pa las rtse mo phra ba kha sprod du yod pa ni yab yum gnyis dang /de nas shar ngos su rim bzhin byang gi gnyan chen thang lha dang / kong btsun de mo/ mon yul de mo/ lho brag sku lha mkha' ri/ yar lha sham bu/ gtsang du jo mo kha dbrag mal gror bdud rtsi sman mo/ chos 'khor rgyal du stag rgod shing byang sogs 'ol de gong rgyal gyi sras sros yin zer/ yul der 'ol dga' zhes pa'ang de ltar byung / 'ol dga' nas byang shar ngos spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le bcu tsam song na rdzing phyi grong dbus su dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ 66rdzing phyi ha zhes pa ni thog mar bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi bka' ltar khams nas phebs pa'i bshes gnyen sgar mi yon tan g.yung drung zhes bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma zhig gis phyag btab gnang mdzad/ dgon de phyag ma btab gong / bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis gnang ba'i rgyal ba byams pa'i sku byin can la gsol ba btab pas 66brag lha gser khang nas rdzing ma gi'i phyi tsam du rtsigs ::zhes lung bstan pas yul ming dang dgon ming bcas par rdzing phyi zhes thogs/ dgon de bzhengs bsgrubs rjes kyi rten gtsor gong gsal dzhai k+ṣim gyi rje btsun byams pa'i sku byis pa lo brgyad tsam zhig gi thugs gar tsan dan de ba'i nags khrod nas 'khrungs pa'i tsan dan gyi byams pa khru
gang pa zhig de'i thugs kur shel gyi byams pa mkhyil nas bzhugs pa byin can zhig sogs mjal rgyu yod/ skabs der chos grwa rgyas te dge 'dun lnga brgya skor zin/ de nas rim bzhin nyams rgud du song nas rje tsong kha pa la rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis lung bstan pa ltar der phebs skabs byams pa'i dbu la bya brun dang / thal rdul gyis khengs shing gtsug lag khang yang gog por gyur pa gzigs pas thugs skyo nas spyan chab shor/ de nas 'ol kha stag rtse rdzong la sbyin bdag zhus nas nyams gso gnang / rje khong rang gi gtor chas btsongs nas dngul zho gang byung ba las rgyal chen rnam sras la grogs dan bcol bas ltung bshags lha so lnga bri mi dgos par rang bzhin du gyang ldebs su gsal zhes gsungs/ rje rin po che'i mdzad chen bzhi las gcig 'di nyid yin/ rjes su 'on rgyal sras rin po che'i dgon par gyur/ dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu tsam zin/da lta nyams gso zhus pa'i 'du khang nang sngon gyi byams pa'i zhabs g.yas pa'i steng sman 'dam gyi byams pa'i sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang /g.yas su spyan ras gzigs kha sar pa ṇi/ g.yon du rdo rje sems dpa'/de'i g.yas su thub dbang thog brtsegs gcig ldan/ g.yon du thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong thog so gcig lhag mtha' 'khor du nye sras brgyad sgo srung dang bcas thog so gcig lhag gzhan yang sgar mi yon tan g.yung drung dang / rje yab sras gsum/ rgyal ba 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs kyi 'jim sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / lhag tu rje rin po che'i zhabs rjes dang /phyag rjes/ ltung bshags kyi ldebs ris rnying ma sogs mjal rgyu yod/yang dgon de'i gsham du rgyal ba 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs yul du pho brang rnying pa'i gyang gog kyang mjal rgyu yod/

su grags/ tsa ri la'ang phyi nang gsum gyi gnas ri yod pa ni kong po sman gling du ri bo lha ri 'dzin nam tsa ri gsar ma tshe ribaljongs zhes pa dang gcigyang skyes dkar thang nas nags la dang / spang la/ rdza la bcas brgyab na tsa ri mtsho dkar zhes pas gnyis/ yang cig car nas sgrol ma la brgyud dkyil 'khor ram/ dag pa shel ri bcas gsum so sor mjal rgyu yod pa la de gsum ni rtsa ro rkyang dbu gsum mam phyi nang gsang gsum/ sku gsung thugs bcas kyi mtshon don yod pas de dag so so la'ang dag pa shel ri mtsho gling dang bcas pa'i bkod pa re yod ces gsungs/ tsa ri dkyil 'khor te dag pa shel ri ni thog mar rgyal ba'i lung gis zin la/ bar du chos rgyal srong btsan dang / gu ru pad ma 'byung gnas sogs kyi gzigs snang sna tshogs byung / de rjes mnyam med dwags po lha rjer tsa ri'i gnas kyi gzigs snang byung stabs slob ma rnams la khyed sus tsa ri'i gnas sgo 'byed ces tsa rir phyag mdzub gtad pas gnas tsa ri bka' shin tu gnyan stabs de mar phyag mdzub la chu bur bdun shar/ nyin gsum song yang slob ma rnams kyis nga 'gro zhes khas len zhu mkhan ma byung / nyin gsum par skyes bu ye shes rdo rjer spyan ched gnyer gzigs pas bla mas nga la gsungs pa 'dra dgongs nas khas len zhus pas bla ma thugs shin tu mnyes/ skyes bu ye shes rdo rje dpon slob bcu gcig dang bcas pa tsa ri'i gnas sgo phye bar phebs/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can mched gsum gyis rnal 'byor pa khyed sdug rus che ba/ lus srog la ltos pa med pa zhig 'dug ste cha lugs 'di lta bus pha bla ma'i thugs dgongs kyang mi rdzogs/ ma mkha' 'gro mnyes pa yang mi 'gyur/ gnas tsa ri'i sgo yang mi phye/ nang sprul pa'i lha zhal yang mi mthong / mchog thun mong gi dngos grub kyang mi thob pas tsa ri'i gnas sgo 'byed par 'dod na sang phod da tsam na mgo la chu zhwa/ rkang par chu lham/ lag tu chu ber khyer nas spos kyi dud pa rgyun

yod/ / glang chen zas kyi dngos grub yod/ / ma dang mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs yod/ / ma sgom sangs rgyas de na yod/ / nya ces gdams pa'i mos la yal ba'i gzigs snang zhig byung bas tsa rir byon pa'i dgongs pa mngon du btang nas byon pas gong gsal 'bri gung gi mnyos 'gar chos gsum dang /zhal 'dzoms byung ste lhan du phebs/ thog mar khye'u gzhon nu rta gro ser g.yu'i rngog ma can zhig la bzhon pa zhig gis bla ma khyed rnams 'di nas yar phebs na/ rib pa zhig las med ces zhus pa bzhin phebs pas 66rib pa la zhes pa de ltar byung / de nas mkha' ldeng brag 'go dang / de nas yul stod sbal pa mtshor phebs pas sbal pa g.yag shas tsam 'jigs su rung ba zhig gis lam bkag nas yod pa de'i steng du mchongs nas drag tu brdzis pas pha bong zhig tu gyur/ de la zhabs rjes shin tu bkra ba mang po byung ba deng sang mjal rgyu yod/de nas yul smad du byon pa na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'bum tshogs pa'i gras labyon/ de nas chos rje skyob chen la kha nas cig car du gshegs pa'i lam bar du mi ma yin gyis mo mtshan mang du sprul nas lam bkag pa na gsang ba'i rdo rje las su rung bar mdzad nas de la bsnun pas brag tu song ba'i rjes gsal bar dod/ de nas mkha' 'gro'i rdo'i snying phug brnyes/ der zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje g.yu'i sgrol ma dam la btags pas g.yu sgrol mas bka' bzhin sgrub pa dang / rjes 'jug skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes/ sman btsun de mo des las kyi phyag rgya mdzad/ zhing skyong seng gdong mas kyang ci bsgo ba thams cad nyan par dam bcas/ de nas mar phebs te rang byung rol pa'i khri la bzhugs dus phyogs skyong gshin rje'i rgyal po khye'u lo brgyad kyi gzugs yid du 'ong ba'i tshul gyi spyan sngar 'ong / gus pas btud de dge bsnyen mnyos/mtshan cig car dmar por btags/ rje'i 'phrin las grub par khas blangs/de nas mar byon pas sha zam la rtse nas slar yang mnyos 'gar chos gsum dang

dgon gnas der mtsho yin pa dang / de nas gnas de'i yul lha khyi kha ra thod ces pas mtsho de brtol/ de rjes mtsho mig tu klu gdol pa nag po ces pa gdug pa can zhig mtsho der gnas te skye 'gror gnod chen po byas pas de'i kha gnon du shud po dpal seng gi gdung rabs bcu drug pa grub thob las kyo rdo rje'am lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhu ba spyi lo 1326lor sku bltams/dgung lo gsum pa la phur pa'i dbang thob pas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro rnams gar byed pa'i snang ba shar bas gar sgyur gyi phyag rgya mang po mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu pa la khu bo rgyal sras bzang po las rab tu byung / dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la phur pa khro bcur bskor ba zhig la bsnyen pa du ma mdzad pas ngag nus che bas sdig pa la sngags chu reg pa tsam gyis shi ba la snying rje 'khrungs nas bshums pas phur pa'i zhal gzigs kyang thob/ de nas mtsho shul der dgon pa zhig 'debs dgos thugs la 'khrungs te thig bskyon pa la mtshan mo lha 'dres phyis pas thig phyi zhes pa'i mtshan yang de las byung / de ltar lha 'dres ko long phrag dog byas pa'i ru gnon du phyogs bzhi dang dbus bcas par mchod rten lnga bzhengs/ de nas thig phyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ dgon de'i rgyab ri ni phyi glang chen gyi gzugs 'dra ba la nang bya khyung gi rang byon dang /de'i lto ba'i thad du rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha khang dang / glang chen gyi mchu steng du'ang dgon pa zhig yod pa de gnyis la khyung tshang zhes zer yang / 'jigs byed lha khang la dgon pa mthil zhes kyang zer/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi chos 'khor shin tu rgyas te dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga brgya tsam byung ba las phul du byung ba'i slob ma nam mkha' lhan rgyas dang /nam mkha' lhun grub gnyis byung ba dang / de las lhag pa rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa byung zhes gsungag sngon dgon de dga' ldan bla spyi'i khongs yin cing / mkhan po'ang dga' ldan byang rtse nas phebs dgos/ da lta 'tsho
bzhugs blo bzang tshe ring mchog bar nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sku phreng gnyis las ma byung / sngon 'du khang nang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi phyag bzo 'dra sku mthong ba don sgrol dang / gtsang khang sbug mar sman 'dam gyi dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / g.yas g.yon nye sras brgyad/ sgo srung gnyis dang bcas pa/dbus su nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sku dmar gdung bzhugs pa'i gser zangs kyi gdung rten thog brtseg gnyis ldan dang / 'du khang nang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi phyag bzo phyag rdor gtum mo me 'bar gyis gtsos pa'i 'khor chen brgyad/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ rje yab sras gsum/ sbug tu 'od dpag med lha khang sogs rten gsum khyad du 'phags pa gnas der bzhugs su gsol yod/da lta nyams gso zhus pa'i gtsang khang sbug mar sku rgyu sa las bzhengs pa'i gdung rten nang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sku sha tshal bu bzhugs pa nyams gso gnang ba dang / 'du khang nang shing rtsa rin po che'i phyag bzo gu ru'i sku/rje tsong kha pa/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bcas kyi sman sku thog so gcig lhaggzhan yang phyag rdor gyi sku dang / ldebs ris rnying pa mang po sogs mjal rgyu yod/spro ba dgon/ mtshan gzhan la 66sgro ba dgon nam/ bgro ba dgon ji zhes sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs mi 'dra ba so so mchis/thig phyi dgon nas spyi le brgyad tsam spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud shar ngos su song na lam steng du dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ thog mar gnas der nam mkha' rgyal mtshan rta mgrin sgrub gnang nas bzhugs skabs rta skad lan gsum brgyab kyang yul de'i mis ma thos stabs yul der 'on lung zhes kyang 'dogs gnang mdzad pas da lta'ang ming de ltar 'bod kyi yod/ dus de tsa na
rje tsong kha pa gnyal tsong kha phug tu bzhugs skabs bla ma zab mo dbu ma la mkhas pa zhig dang mjal ba'i thugs smon gnang bar mkha' 'gro'i brda ru tsanakhyod 'di nas lho brag shar du phyin na tshad ldan gyi bla ma mjal ba yod 〉〉 ces pa'i brda byung bas/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dben gnas spro ba dgon du phyag rdor gyi sgrub pa bskyon nas bzhugs yod pa la phyi nyin khong rnam gnyis zhal 'dzoms yong ba'i snga nub tu nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la 'jam dbyangs kyi mtshan lam dang / tsong kha par phyag rdor gyi mtshan lam byung / phyi nyin nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis nye gnas la de ring 'grul pa gal chen po zhig yong ba yod pas ltos gsungs par/ gang 'tshams na nye gnas kyis gzhan su zhig min 'dug a mdo gnas skor ba zhig yong gi 'dug ces zhus par yar gdan drongs gsungs nas khong rnam gnyis zhal 'dzoms byung skabs der nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dgung lo bdun cu dang / tsong kha pa dgung lo so dgu yin par grags/ de nas nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang rje tsong kha pa chos gsung res mdzad pa'i tshe na bzhugs khrir nga gnyis gas bzhugs 'dod ma gnang ba'i skabs der nam mkha' nas 64nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bla ma'i tshul du bzhugs dang / blo bzang grags pa slob ma'i tshul du bzhugs ji zhes pa'i sgra byung bas nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes pa'i mtshan yang de ltar byung bar grags/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ni rje tsong kha pa'i dbu bla thun mong ma yin pa bzhi'i mchog gcig yin gsungs/ de nas rje tsong kha par zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba 'khrungs/nyi ma shar ba dang dus mtshungs shar ri nas sangs rgyas stong gi zhal gzigs byung bas stong ri nyi shar zhes pa'ang de nas byung / bla slob gnyis thugs shin tu spro bas 88spro ba dgon 〉 dang / yang bka' gdams dang / phyag na rdo rje'i chos skor bgro gleng mdzad pas 66bgro ba dgon nyagasogs gsung srol ltar 'bri srol yang mi 'dra/ de nas tsong kha pas da nga'i dgon pa gang du btab na
legs sam zhus par/ khyod kyi dgon pa 'brog dga' ldan zhes par thobs gsungs/ chos ji 'dra ba zhig spel dgos sam zhes zhus par/ khyod sger lugs shig bgyis gsungs pas 66dge lugs nya zhes pa de 66sger lugs ji zhes pa'i sgra las byung gsungs/ yang dge lugs zhes pa ni/ dga' ldan pa zhes pa las byung zhing / dga' ldan zhes 'bod na brjod la mi bde bas 66dge lugs nya zhes 'bod ces sogs gsungs tshul mi 'dra/ nga'i dgon pa btab tshar rjes rab gnas su phebs par zhu zhus par zhal bgyis bzhes/ 'on kyang dga' ldan dgon pa phyag btab bsgrubs rjes rab gnas gnang bar nye ba'i dus nam mkha' rgyal mtshan snyun te phebs ma thub par stong ri nyi shar steng nas rab gnas gnang rgyu dang / de nyin dga' ldan gyi sgo dang sge'u khung phye rgyu gnang bar tshes grangs dus bkag gnang ba nor stabs sgo dang sge'u khung phye rgyu ma byung bas phyag nas skor lam du thor ba'i rang byon yang mjal rgyu yod ces gsungs/ sngon dgon der rdo nag la rdo dkar gyi ma ga'i rang byon ngo mtshar can dang / shud po dpal seng gi sku dmar gdung bzhugs pa'i gdung rten/nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sgrub phug nang mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam mjal rgyu yod pa dang / de'i nang bsangs btang na nyin bdun song mtshams stong ri nyi shar gyi rtse nas du ba thon zer/da lta gsar bzhengs 'du khang dang sgrub phug nang gsar bzhengs gu ru'i sku brnyan dang / ma ṇi'i rang byon/ shud bu dpal gyi seng ge'i gdung rten/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri sogs mjal rgyu yod/yang dgon de nas dngos shos zhes pa'i nang rkang thang mar chu tshod gcig lhag tsam song na bsam grub gling zhes pa'i dgon zhig kyang mjal rgyu yod/
mkhar chu dgon/ mtshan rgyas par 6tsamakhar chu dga' ldan bdud 'joms gling ji zhes zhu/ thig phyi dgon nas 'khor lam brgyud spyi le sum cu so bzhi tsam song na lha khang du 'byor/ de nas lho ngos kyi nags rir rkang thang mar chu tshod gnyis lhag tsam dang / 'khor lam brgyud spyi le brgyad dgu tsam song na lcags phur can zhes pa'i ri bo'i steng thang shing dang shug pa la sogs ljon shing sna tshogs kyi khrod du dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ 66mkhar chu ji zhes pa ni brag mkhar bde mchog rang byon nam mkha' la bsnyegs 'dra'i mdun nas phu chu rgyugs pas mkhar chu zhes 'bod/ zhes pa las mkhar chu'i mtshan byung gsungs/ yang gsungs srol gzhan zhig ni/ phu yi gangs ri shel dkar gyi ba gam brtsegs pa lta bu nas phyogs kun du yan lag brgyad ldan gyi bdud rtsi dwangs shing bsil ba 'o ma'i rgyun ltar 'bab pa de lha mo mkhar chen gyi ri bo der mkhar bas 66mkhar chu 〉〉zhes pa'i mtshan de ltar byung yang gsungs/dgon de ni thog mar 'brug pa pad ma dkar pos spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu drug pa'i nang phyag btab gnang mdzad/ de rjes gnubs kyi rigs 'khrungs dge slong nam mkha'i snying po'i mchog sprul slar yang bstan 'gro'i don du byon pa dge slong lha mchog nas da bar sku phreng rim byon gyis 'dul sde bskyangs gnang gis mdzad 'phrin shin tu rgyas/ rgyal mchog lnga pas kyang mthun rkyen bka' drin bla med stsal gnang mdzad tshul sogs gsungs/ dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya la nye bas nyer lnga tshes bcu sogs byang gter phyag bzhes gnang gi yod pa la/ bla ma gsang 'dus te gu ru chos dbang gi gter ma sogs kyang phyag bzhes mdzad kyi yod/ sngon 'du khang thog brtseg gsum ldan gyi gtsang khang sbug mar sman 'dam gyi gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje thog brtseg gsum tsam lon pa'i gzungs su sor mo'i tshad tsam gyi gu ru'i sku khri bcu gnyis
tsam bzhugs pa/ g.yas su sku rgyu de mtshungs kyi 'od dpag med dang /mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ g.yon du thugs rje chen po dang rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi 'dra sku thog brtseg lhag dbu steng du gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor/gzhan yang kun mkhyen pad dkar gyis bzhengs pa'i gser zangs kyi rgyal ba mi 'khrug pa thog brtseg gcig lhag nam snying sku phreng drug pa'i gser zangs kyi gdung rten/ gzhan yang byu ru'i sdong po dang dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sogs nang rten ji snyed cig bzhugs su gsol yod/da lta sngon gyi gyang ror nyams gso zhus pa'i 'du khang nang gong gsal sku de dag gi sku tshab sku rgyu dang sku tshad de mtshungs gsar bzhengs gnang yod pa dang / gu ru'i sku tshab nyer lnga zhes pa'i gras shig dang / nam mkha'i snying po'i sku chos nyi zer ma sogs bzhugs su gsol ba mjal rgyu yod/gzhan yang dgon de ni gu ru'i thugs kyi dben gnas te dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyi gshog pa 'dra ba'i nang 'og min lcags phur can zhes pa'i phug tu gu rus lo bdun zla bdun/ zhag bdun sgrub pa bskyon pa/ de'i lam gyi brag la ma cig gi zhabs rjes/ gu ru'i phyag 'khar dang / phyag mdzub kyi rjes sogs 'dam la btab pa bzhin gsal ba'i ri steng du dgon de chags/shar rir sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rang byon gral ring du bzhugs 'dra dang /de'i mdun du g.yu yi rdo bcas bting 'dra'i lha mo g.yu sgron ma'i bla mtsho dang /dngul gzhongs ja thang gis bskangs 'dra'i zhing skyong gi bla mtsho/ gter bdag dge gnyen smyon kha'i bla mtsho bcas ni sgrol ma'i rang byon mdun yon chab phul ba bzhin yod/ de nas lho ngos su rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang byon gsal ba'i khrod/ lho don yod sgrub pa'i sku skyed kyi mtshams su rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i sgrub phug lho nub kyi mtshams su rdo skas dang shing zam brgyud mar babs na rong chu 'gro ba 'dren pa'i chu rgyun dang / de nas tsa ri'i rlung sgo zhes
pa dang brag mkhar bde mchog rang byon sogs tsa ri gnyis pa yin zhes gsungs/ nub ngos su nam mkha'i snying por gu rus lung bstan pa'i dpal gyi phu ring sgrub phug de dang nye bar mtsho rgyal gyi gsang ba'i phug pa dang / grub thob me long rdo rje'i gdan sa dang dur khrod sogs mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de nas mi ring ba'i sar gangs la brgyab nas song na mon ku ru lung zhes pa'i mdor o rgyan rin po che'i phur pa 'phrin las kyi sgrub gnas khyad par can mon khani ring seng ge rdzong gsum zhes pa mjal rgyu yod kyang mtha' mtshams song bas mjal stabs bde po med/lha khang / mtshan rgyas par 66mkho mthing rnam snang lha khang ji zhes zhu/mkhar chu dgon nas rkang thang mar chu tshod gcig lhag mar babs na lha khang grong dbus su snga nyams ldan pa'i lha khang de mjal rgyu yod/ de ni mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang khongs dbus kyi rnam par snang mdzad zhu ba de yin/ thog mar yul der mkho mthing zhes zer ba la rjes su mtha' 'dul gyi lha khang de bzhengs stabs lha khang zhes pa'i ming de ltar thogs/ sngon lha khang de'i nang sman 'dam gyi rnam snang sku thog brtseg gsum tsam dang /gzhan yang rten sku mang po mjal rgyu yod pa la mtha' 'khor lcags ri dang sgo bzhi'ang yod/ bsam yas bzhengs skabs dang dus mtshungs/ mkho mthing rnam snang gi sku rgyab nas gter sgrom sprug po dang / skya bo gnyis bton pa'i sgrom nang nas bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud gter las bzhes zhes gsungs/da lta lha khang rnying pa de'i nang sangs rgyas stong sku'i ldebs ris mjal rgyu yod la dgon de'i kha sprod du 'khor lam steng ma ṇi'i rang byon gsal ba zhig mjal rgyu yod pas de bye mas nub dus bskal pa'i mtha' ru slebs zhes zer/
130 nyo brag rdzong khongs/ rilha khang nas rkang thang mar chu tshod gsum tsam song na gu ru'i tshe yi sgrub pa mdzad sa tshe bum dpal gyi ri zhes o rgyan gyi sgrub phug dang / tshe chu sogs yod/ de nas mu mthud song na sdur zhes par o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdan sa'ang mjal rgyu yod/sras mkhar dgu thog mtshan rgyas par 66sras gsang sngags chos gling ha zhes zhu/ mkho mthing lha khang nas spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud seng ge rdzong ste da lta'i seng ge chus dang / de nas khams pa la babs/ de nas chu gsum mdo zhes pa nas lho nang ste sras khul du spyi le sum cu tsam song na sras grong tsho'i dbus su dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de ni thog mar bka' brgyud bstan pa'i srol gtod pa mar pa lo tsā'i slob ma'i phul du byung ba mi la ras pa gcig pus 1077lor bzhengs gnang mdzad/ mi la ras pa ni yul la stod mang yul gung thang gi bye brag skya rnga rtsa bya bar yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / yum myang tsha dkar rgyan gyi sras su spyi lo 1040lor sku bltams/chung ngu'i dus nas yab grongs pas khu bo dang a nes nor gzhis phyogs/ yum gyi bkas dbus su byon nas mthu ser gyis dgra thams cad pham par mdzad/de ltar sdig pa bsags pa la thugs 'gyod drag po skyes te rong ston lha dga' zhu ba la rdzogs chen zhu dus/ rong ston lha dgas lho gro bo lung dgon pa na rgya gar gyi grub chen na ro pa'i dngos slob mar pa lo tsā zhes bya ba'i grub thob 'gran zla bral ba zhig bzhugs pa'i skor gsungs pas mi bzod pa'i dad gus skyes te lho gro bo lung du phebs/ mi la dang mar pa mjal ba'i snga nub tu mar par gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa zhig la g.ya' cung zad yod pa zhig rmis gnang bas yum bdag med mar de ring 'grul pa gal chen zhig 'ong ba yod pas khyod kyis chang dam bi gang sdogs shig gsungs nas chang de bsnams nas gro bo lung
'og tu mthun rkyen zhing zhes pa der phru slog bzhin bzhugs tsa na mi la der phebs te mar pa yin pa ma mkhyen par mar pa lo tsā zhes pa gang du bzhugs yod med bka' 'dri zhus par/ mar pas khyod kyis zhing 'di'i phru slog 'phro rnams slog chang 'thung 'phro 'di btungs nas khang pa ya gir shog dang ngas bla ma bstan gsungs/ mi las de ltar gnang nas zhing rmo 'phro de rmos/ chang bzhes 'phro de bzhes pas mar pa'i rgyud 'dzin gnang rgyu'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ de nas gro bo lung du yar phebs pas mar pa ni da lta zhing rmo ba'i thal rdul dang bcas bzhugs yod pas bla ma mar pa de min nam snyam/ gar pas khyod dogs pa ma byed/ bla ma mar pa nga yin pas phyag 'tshol gsungs pa la/ mi las the tshom med par phyag 'tshal te dad gus dang bcas lto gos chos gsum bla mas gnang bar zhu zhus par/ chos gsung rgyu zhal gyis ma bzhes par thog mar sgrib sbyong gi ched du sras dar ma mdo sde'i sku mkhar brtsig tu bcug gnang mdzad/ sras mkhar zhes pa'ang de nas byung / thog mar shar ngos su sgor mo rnga 'dra ba zhig brtsigs pas thog brtseg bzhi tsam lon skabs gshig bcug gnang bas ma tshad sa rdo gnas so sor skyel du 'jug gnang mdzad/yang byang gi ri rtse dang / nub kyi ri sna so sor zla gam dang gru gsum bcas brtsigs pa gong ltar bshig bcug gnang rjes mthar dbus kyi gru bzhi thog brtseg dgu ldan de bzhengs gnang mdzad skabs mi la'i sku gzugs la rma bzos te rnag khrag kyang babs pa bu chen rnams kyis thugs mi bzod par rdo chen po zhig rtsig steng du bzhag gnang ba mar pas gzigs te/ rdo 'dis khyod kyi go mi chod gsungs nas slar yang rang gnas su skyel du 'jug gnang mdzad rjes/ mi las yang bskyar sku rgyab tu bsnams nas rtsig gdan du bkyon pa'i mi la'i rgyab rdo zhes pa da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ 'on kyang rje btsun mi las bla ma mar par dad log cung zad kyang mi gnang bar mkhar de bzhengs/ snga phyir

gtsang khang ka gnyis nang 'brog khri dpon gyis bzhengs pa'i gser zangs kyi thub dbang gzungs su sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel/ mdzod pur pad rag bzhugs pa thog so nyis thog dang / 'jim sku las grub pa'i bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi 'dra sku tshems byon ma dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du gser zangs kyi dus 'khor dang bde mchog mtha' 'khor du nye sras brgyad dang khro bo bcas kyi 'jim sku thog so re/ 'du khang nang gser zangs kyi phyogs las rnam rgyal gsung 'byon mi tshad ma/ li ma'i dgyes rdor lha dgu khru gang tsam/yid dam dang chos skyong khrag gi gnyan thang sogs mang po yod/ gsang sngags pho brang ka ba bcu gnyis nang bka' blon bshad grwa don grub rdo rjes sbyin bdag mdzad pa'i dngul gdung byang chub mchod rten dang / g.yon du rnam rgyal mchod rten g.yas su byang chub mchod rten bcas thog so gnyis ldan khra rgyan sna tshogs kyis spud pa sogs ji snyed cig mjal rgyu yod/da lta sngon gyi gtsug lag khang gi phyed tsam ste shar ngos kyi gyang ro'i steng gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i gtsang khang nang thub dbang bdud 'dul ma'i 'jim sku thog so gnyis ldan nye sras brgyad kyis bskor ba dang / 'du khang nang 'jim las grub pa'i bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje phag mo/ gu ru mtshoskyes rdo rje sogs sngon gyi sku 'dra'i sku tshab mang po gsar bzhengs gnang yod la/ i ḍa lir par du bskrun pa'i bo dong gi gsung rtsom pod brgya lhag deng dus lugs gsar gyi deb tu bkod pa sogs mjal rgyu yod/dgon de nas shar ngos su 'khor lam spyir btang ba brgyud rkang thang mar nyin gcig tsam phyin na khyam zhes pa'i yul du yar 'brog yon po rdo zhes pa der slebs kyi red/ dgon de ni rig 'dzin chen mo mdo sngags 'byung gnas kyis phyag btab gnang ba dang / yon po rdo zhes pa ni sgrol ma nyer gcig dus gcig tu zhal gzigs pa'i gnas rdo chen po zhig yod stabs yon
po rdo zhes pa'i mtshan de ltar byung zhes gsungs/ dgon de gnas yul ni mtsho dkyil ri 'bur gyi pang khar chags yod pa dang / dgon de'i mdun ngos mtsho nang du gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyi phyag g.yas pa'i phyag rjes gsal bas/de'ang le'u bdun pa las (8grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi la phyag rjes bzhag 〉〉ces pa'i mtsho chen bzhi'i nang tshan zhig yin/ ri bo'i rtse mor rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i bla shing zhes shug sdong nyi shu rtsa lnga'ang yod/ da lta nyams gso gnang ba'i dgon gnas rten dang bcas pa mjal rgyu yod la/ da dung gu ru rin po che dang / mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal sogs kyi sgrub gnas dang gzhan yang yon po rdo'i gnas rdo sogs mjal rgyu yod/yang yar 'brog bsam gling nas spyi le brgya lhag dang / mtsho smad nas spyi le drug cu lhag tsam song na btsan chen mdo zhes par shing rtsa dgon zhes pa de mjal rgyu yod/ shing rtsa zhes pa ni shing pa ma skyes pa'i ri 'dabs sam rtsa ba la chags pas mtshan de ltar byung / dgon de ni 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi slob ma'i slob ma grags pa rin chen zhu bas phyag btab gnang mdzad/ da lta 'tsho bzhugs shing rtsa bstan 'dzin chos grags bar sku phreng bcu bzhi byung /'brug pa bka' brgyud phyag bzhes gnang gi yod/ sngon dgon der shing rtsa sku phreng rim byon gyi gsung 'bum bris ma ji snyed cig bzhugs su gsol yod/dge 'dun zhal grangs kyang sum cu tsam yod/ shing rtsa sgrub sde zhes sgrub pa kho na bskyon nas bzhugs pa red/ sngon rten gtso gser zangs kyi rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa gtso 'khor gsum mi tshad lhag dang / li ma'i sangs rgyas stong sku/bka' 'gyur lha khang nas bka' 'gyur bris ma/ ka drug lha khang nang grags pa rin chen nas bzung sku phreng rim byon gyi dngul gdung dang / sman 'dam gyi 'dra sku sogs yod/ ras rkyang zhes rtsa rlung la rang dbang thob pa'i slob ma stong tsho brgal ba byung myong yod gsungs/ da lta sngon gyi dgon shul gyi gsham
